## Decisions Made

| Decision | Rationale | Files |
|----------|-----------|-------|
| 'abandoned' state | Distinguish host-left from completed games | supabase.ts, DB migration |
| 300ms delay on reveal | Let host finish score calculations before player fetches | play.ts |
| No retry logic | Keep it simple, 300ms delay is sufficient | play.ts |
| Playwright multi-context | Test host + multiple players interacting | playwright.config.ts, tests/ |
| Real Supabase for tests | More realistic than mocking | TESTING.md |
| Host reconnect modal | Let host choose continue vs abandon | host.html, host.ts |
| Player auto-reconnect | Check localStorage on page load | play.ts |
